claims.value: Hermes 2 Pro is an upgraded, retrained version of Nous Hermes 2, trained on an updated OpenHermes 2.5 Dataset plus an in-house Function Calling and JSON Mode dataset. It excels at function calling (90% evaluation score) and JSON structured outputs (84% score). Uses ChatML format with multi-turn function calling support. Added new tokens for agentic capabilities during streaming.
claims.evidence: Hermes 2 Pro is an upgraded, retrained version of Nous Hermes 2, consisting of an updated and cleaned version of the OpenHermes 2.5 Dataset

claims.value: This model is built on the Llama 3 8B base model from NousResearch, fine-tuned with ChatML, DPO, RLHF, function calling, and JSON mode capabilities.

claims.evidence: scoring a 90% on our function calling evaluation built in partnership with Fireworks.AI
an 84% on our structured JSON Output evaluation
Hermes 2 Pro uses ChatML as the prompt format
This format enables OpenAI endpoint compatability
tags: - Llama-3 - instruct - finetune - chatml - DPO - RLHF

claims.value: Tool calls must be parsed by inference code; the model generates JSON tool call structures that follow a specific format with name and arguments fields.
claims.evidence: The model will then generate a tool call, which your inference code must parse

claims.value: The primary training dataset is teknium/OpenHermes-2.5, which provides the conversational and instruction-following data used for fine-tuning.
The model uses the Llama 3 license.
The model is trained on English language data.
